name: io.github.junyeong-nero/kitsune
title: Kitsune
description: Let your coding agent use the Firefox, Zen, or LibreWolf browser you already have open.

environmentVariables.name: KITSUNE_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Task surface and per-request policy: read, draft, or act

environmentVariables.name: KITSUNE_CAPS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated capability groups to enable; all enables every group except storage and history

environmentVariables.name: KITSUNE_PUBLISH
environmentVariables.description: Groups listed when a session starts; other enabled tools stay reachable through the gateway tools

environmentVariables.name: KITSUNE_ASK_BEFORE_ACT
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to hold submits, payment pages, JavaScript, and cookie access until the call is confirmed
